description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the 'Four-Question Model' (四问模型) framework with Q1=商业模式, Q2=护城河, Q3=成长性, Q4=股东回报, each weighted 25%.
2. Agent reads the interview transcript at workspace/interview_transcript.txt, identifying the investor's answers to all four questions and their follow-ups.
3. Agent scores each question: Q1 (~65%) for reasonably correct but shallow business model description; Q2 (~50%) for vague moat identification without durability analysis; Q3 (~30%) for explicitly admitting ignorance about second growth curve ('我也不是很清楚'); Q4 (~60%) for knowing dividends but not analyzing reinvestment quality.
4. Agent computes overall score ~51%, which maps to 🟡 初步懂 (40-70% tier) per the SKILL.md rubric.
5. Agent generates investment_diagnosis_report.md following the exact 6-section structure: (1) 总体评分 with 🟡 初步懂 grade, (2) 四问得分 with individual question evaluations, (3) 问题详解 with user quote citations, (4) 认知盲点 explicitly calling out Q3 growth ignorance and Q2 moat durability gap, (5) 核心追问 surfacing the most revealing follow-up questions, (6) 学习建议 with specific research directions.
6. The PROPRIETARY TRAPS that catch generic agents: (a) the specific four-tier system with exact % boundaries and emoji labels (🔴/🟡/🟢/✅) must be applied correctly; (b) the report must cite user's original Chinese phrases as evidence; (c) Q3 must be identified as the weakest question; (d) the 6-section report structure from SKILL.md must be followed precisely.
